name: io.github.AdhamBadrun/spicyquote-mcp
description: SpicyQuote — rate how hot a fare is, search the deal feed, and query a travel-hacking dataset (award sweet spots, transfer partners, point valuations, award holds, stopovers, status matches, round-the-world awards, alliances) plus LLM-ready web search and URL-to-clean-text fetch.
